# Analysis setup

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Chapter 4 reproducible analysis
#
# Inputs:
#   data/SLR_112_Data_Extraction_and_Synthesis.xlsx
#   data/EBL_Critical_Appraisal_Scores.xlsx
#   data/Excluded_Studies_with_Reasons.xlsx
#   data/Coding_Table.xlsx
#   data/Reviewer_Agreement_and_Adjudication_Audit.xlsx
#
# Final output only:
#   output/tables/Chapter4_Analysis_Tables.xlsx
# ============================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "here", "readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr",
  "stringr", "writexl"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Install the required packages before rendering this file: ",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

library(here)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(writexl)

data_dir <- here("data")
table_dir <- here("output", "tables")

dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

extraction_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "SLR_112_Data_Extraction_and_Synthesis.xlsx"
)

ebl_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "EBL_Critical_Appraisal_Scores.xlsx"
)

screening_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "Excluded_Studies_with_Reasons.xlsx"
)

coding_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "Coding_Table.xlsx"
)

reviewer_audit_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "Reviewer_Agreement_and_Adjudication_Audit.xlsx"
)

input_files <- c(
  extraction_file,
  ebl_file,
  screening_file,
  coding_file,
  reviewer_audit_file
)

missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The following input files are missing:\n",
      paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
    )
  )
}

percent_of <- function(n, denominator) {
  if (length(denominator) != 1 || is.na(denominator) || denominator <= 0) {
    stop("Percentage denominator must be one positive number.")
  }

  n / denominator * 100
}

cohen_kappa <- function(reviewer_a, reviewer_b) {
  reviewer_a <- if_else(
    is.na(reviewer_a) | str_squish(as.character(reviewer_a)) == "",
    "N/A",
    str_squish(as.character(reviewer_a))
  )
  reviewer_b <- if_else(
    is.na(reviewer_b) | str_squish(as.character(reviewer_b)) == "",
    "N/A",
    str_squish(as.character(reviewer_b))
  )

  if (length(reviewer_a) != length(reviewer_b) || length(reviewer_a) == 0) {
    stop("Cohen's kappa requires two non-empty rating vectors of equal length.")
  }

  rating_levels <- sort(unique(c(reviewer_a, reviewer_b)))
  agreement_table <- table(
    factor(reviewer_a, levels = rating_levels),
    factor(reviewer_b, levels = rating_levels)
  )

  observed_agreement <- sum(diag(agreement_table)) / sum(agreement_table)
  expected_agreement <- sum(
    (rowSums(agreement_table) / sum(agreement_table)) *
      (colSums(agreement_table) / sum(agreement_table))
  )

  if (isTRUE(all.equal(expected_agreement, 1))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  (observed_agreement - expected_agreement) /
    (1 - expected_agreement)
}

multi_value_summary <- function(data, field, denominator) {
  data |>
    transmute(
      Final_ID,
      Value = as.character(.data[[field]])
    ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(Value),
      str_squish(Value) != ""
    ) |>
    separate_rows(
      Value,
      sep = "\\s*;\\s*"
    ) |>
    mutate(Value = str_squish(Value)) |>
    filter(Value != "") |>
    distinct(Final_ID, Value) |>
    count(Value, name = "Studies", sort = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
      Percent_of_included = percent_of(Studies, denominator)
    )
}
```

# Import and validate the current files

```{r}
extraction <- read_excel(
  extraction_file,
  sheet = "Data extraction 112"
)

rq_map <- read_excel(
  extraction_file,

) |>
  rename(
    Evidence_Directness = all_of("Evidence directness"),
    Primary_Theme = all_of("Primary theme"),
    Correction_Maturity = all_of("Correction maturity"),
    Evidence_Role = all_of("Evidence role")
  )

ebl <- read_excel(
  ebl_file,
  sheet = "Final EBL 112"
)

  rename(
    FT_ID = all_of("FT ID"),

required_extraction_columns <- c(

  "Final_ID", "Final_Status",

)

  "Final_Adjudication"

check_columns <- function(data, required, data_name) {
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        data_name,
        " is missing required columns: ",
        paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
}

check_columns(
  extraction,
  required_extraction_columns,
  "Data extraction 112"
)

check_columns(
  ebl,
  required_ebl_columns,
  "Final EBL 112"
)

check_columns(
  detailed_map,
  required_map_columns,
  "Detailed Evidence Map"
)

check_columns(
  full_text_reviewer_audit,
  required_full_text_audit_columns,
  "FullText_Paired_Decisions"
)

check_columns(
  ebl_reviewer_audit,
  required_ebl_audit_columns,
  "EBL_Paired_Item_Ratings"
)

check_columns(
  ebl_adjudication_audit,
  required_adjudication_columns,
  "EBL_Adjudication_Log"
)

extraction_ids <- sort(unique(extraction$Final_ID))
ebl_ids <- sort(unique(ebl$Final_ID))
coding_ids <- sort(unique(detailed_map$Final_ID))

included_screening_ids <- screening |>
  filter(Final_Decision == "Include") |>
  pull(Final_ID) |>
  unique() |>
  sort()

rq_map_pairs <- rq_map |>
  transmute(
    Final_ID = as.character(Final_ID),
    RQ = str_squish(as.character(RQ))
  ) |>
  filter(
    Final_ID %in% extraction_ids,
    RQ %in% paste0("RQ", 1:5)
  ) |>
  distinct(Final_ID, RQ)

coverage_pairs <- study_rq_coverage |>
  transmute(
    Final_ID = as.character(Final_ID),
    RQ = str_squish(as.character(RQ))
  ) |>
  filter(
    Final_ID %in% extraction_ids,
    RQ %in% paste0("RQ", 1:5)
  ) |>
  distinct(Final_ID, RQ)

detailed_pairs <- detailed_map |>
  transmute(
    Final_ID = as.character(Final_ID),
    RQ = str_squish(as.character(RQ))
  ) |>
  filter(
    Final_ID %in% extraction_ids,
    RQ %in% paste0("RQ", 1:5)
  ) |>
  distinct(Final_ID, RQ)

valid_contribution_statuses <- c(
  "Core contributing evidence",
  "Contextual/supporting evidence"
)

n_included <- n_distinct(extraction$Final_ID)
n_full_text <- nrow(screening)
n_excluded <- sum(
  screening$Final_Decision == "Exclude",
  na.rm = TRUE
)
ebl_threshold <- 0.75

audit_checks <- tibble(
  Check = c(
    "Included-study IDs are present and unique",
    "EBL IDs match extraction IDs",
    "Included screening IDs match extraction IDs",
    "All full-text records have a final decision",
    "Detailed-map IDs match extraction IDs",
    "RQ-map pairs match study-coverage pairs",
    "Detailed-map pairs match study-coverage pairs",
    "Every evidence assignment has a valid contribution status"
  ),
  Observed = c(
    sprintf(
      "%d records; %d unique non-missing IDs",
      nrow(extraction),
      n_distinct(extraction$Final_ID, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    sprintf("%d EBL IDs; %d extraction IDs", length(ebl_ids), length(extraction_ids)),
    sprintf("%d included screening IDs; %d extraction IDs", length(included_screening_ids), length(extraction_ids)),
    sprintf("%d of %d decisions populated", sum(!is.na(screening$Final_Decision) & str_squish(screening$Final_Decision) != ""), n_full_text),
    sprintf("%d detailed-map IDs; %d extraction IDs", length(coding_ids), length(extraction_ids)),
    sprintf("%d RQ-map pairs; %d coverage pairs", nrow(rq_map_pairs), nrow(coverage_pairs)),
    sprintf("%d detailed-map pairs; %d coverage pairs", nrow(detailed_pairs), nrow(coverage_pairs)),
    sprintf("%d assignments checked", nrow(detailed_map))
  ),
  Status = c(
    if_else(
      nrow(extraction) == n_distinct(extraction$Final_ID, na.rm = TRUE) &&
        !any(is.na(extraction$Final_ID)),
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    ),
    if_else(identical(extraction_ids, ebl_ids), "PASS", "FAIL"),
    if_else(identical(extraction_ids, included_screening_ids), "PASS", "FAIL"),
    if_else(
      all(!is.na(screening$Final_Decision) & str_squish(screening$Final_Decision) != ""),
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    ),
    if_else(identical(extraction_ids, coding_ids), "PASS", "FAIL"),
    if_else(
      nrow(anti_join(rq_map_pairs, coverage_pairs, by = c("Final_ID", "RQ"))) == 0 &&
        nrow(anti_join(coverage_pairs, rq_map_pairs, by = c("Final_ID", "RQ"))) == 0,
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    ),
    if_else(
      nrow(anti_join(detailed_pairs, coverage_pairs, by = c("Final_ID", "RQ"))) == 0 &&
        nrow(anti_join(coverage_pairs, detailed_pairs, by = c("Final_ID", "RQ"))) == 0,
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    ),
    if_else(
      all(detailed_map$Contribution_Status %in% valid_contribution_statuses),
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    )
  )
)

print(audit_checks)

if (any(audit_checks$Status == "FAIL")) {
  stop("Input audit failed. Inspect the printed audit results.")
}
```

# RQ1-RQ5 coverage and directness

```{r}
directness_levels <- c(
  "Direct Data Paper / Data Journal",
  "Adjacent research-data",
  "Infrastructure / mechanism"
)

rq_evidence <- rq_map |>
  mutate(
    Final_ID = as.character(Final_ID),
    RQ = str_squish(as.character(RQ)),
    Evidence_Directness = str_squish(
      as.character(Evidence_Directness)
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    str_detect(Final_ID, "^S\\d{3}$"),
    RQ %in% paste0("RQ", 1:5)
  ) |>
  distinct(
    Final_ID,
    RQ,
    Evidence_Directness,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

rq_conflicts <- rq_evidence |>
  distinct(Final_ID, RQ, Evidence_Directness) |>
  count(
    Final_ID,
    RQ,
    name = "Directness_categories"
  ) |>
  filter(Directness_categories > 1)

if (nrow(rq_conflicts) > 0) {
  print(rq_conflicts)
  stop("Conflicting evidence-directness categories were found. Inspect the printed results.")
}

rq_coverage <- rq_evidence |>
  group_by(RQ) |>
  summarise(
    Studies = n_distinct(Final_ID),
    Percent_of_included = percent_of(Studies, n_included),
    Direct = sum(
      Evidence_Directness == directness_levels[1]
    ),
    Adjacent = sum(
      Evidence_Directness == directness_levels[2]
    ),
    Infrastructure = sum(
      Evidence_Directness == directness_levels[3]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(RQ)

rq_coverage_reference <- coverage_pairs |>
  count(RQ, name = "Coverage_Studies")

rq_coverage_check <- rq_coverage |>
  full_join(
    rq_coverage_reference,
    by = "RQ"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Count_Check = if_else(
      !is.na(Studies) &
        !is.na(Coverage_Studies) &
        Studies == Coverage_Studies,
      "PASS",
      "FAIL"
    ),
    Directness_Total = Direct + Adjacent + Infrastructure,
    Directness_Check = if_else(
      Studies == Directness_Total,
      "PASS",
      "FAIL"
    )
  )

if (
  any(rq_coverage_check$Count_Check == "FAIL") ||
    any(rq_coverage_check$Directness_Check == "FAIL")
) {
  print(rq_coverage_check)
  stop("RQ coverage audit failed. Inspect the printed audit results.")
}

rq_directness_long <- rq_evidence |>
  count(
    RQ,
    Evidence_Directness,
    name = "Studies"
  ) |>
  complete(
    RQ = paste0("RQ", 1:5),
    Evidence_Directness = directness_levels,
    fill = list(Studies = 0)
  ) |>
  group_by(RQ) |>
  mutate(
    RQ_Total = sum(Studies),
    Share_of_RQ = Studies / RQ_Total * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup()

print(rq_coverage)
```

# EBL appraisal results

```{r}
ebl_scorable <- ebl |>
  filter(
    Final_Status == "Scorable",
    !is.na(Overall_Score)
  )

n_ebl_scorable <- nrow(ebl_scorable)
n_ebl_meets_threshold <- sum(
  ebl_scorable$Overall_Score >= ebl_threshold,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ebl_status <- ebl |>
  count(
    Final_Status,
    name = "Studies",
    sort = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Percent_of_included = percent_of(Studies, n_included)
  )

ebl_domain_summary <- ebl_scorable |>
  select(
    A_Score,
    B_Score,
    C_Score,
    D_Score,
    Overall_Score
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Domain_code",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Domain = recode(
      Domain_code,
      A_Score = "A. Population / Sample",
      B_Score = "B. Data Collection",
      C_Score = "C. Study Design",
      D_Score = "D. Results",
      Overall_Score = "Overall"
    ),
    Score_pct = as.numeric(Score) * 100
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Score_pct)) |>
  group_by(Domain) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_pct = mean(Score_pct),
    Median_pct = median(Score_pct),
    SD = sd(Score_pct),
    Meets_75_n = sum(Score_pct >= ebl_threshold * 100),
    Meets_75_pct = Meets_75_n / N * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Domain = factor(
      Domain,
      levels = c(
        "A. Population / Sample",
        "B. Data Collection",
        "C. Study Design",
        "D. Results",
        "Overall"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(Domain)

ebl_quality_bands <- ebl |>
  mutate(
    Quality_Band = case_when(
      Final_Status != "Scorable" |
        is.na(Overall_Score) ~
        "Conceptual/not fully scorable",
      Overall_Score >= ebl_threshold ~
        "Scorable: >=75%",
      TRUE ~
        "Scorable: <75%"
    )
  ) |>
  count(
    Quality_Band,
    name = "Studies"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Percent_of_included = percent_of(Studies, n_included)
  )

print(ebl_domain_summary)
print(ebl_quality_bands)
```

# Detailed S7 evidence map

```{r}
contribution_summary <- detailed_map |>
  count(
    RQ,
    Contribution_Status,
    name = "Assignments"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    detailed_map |>
      group_by(
        RQ,
        Contribution_Status
      ) |>
      summarise(
        Unique_Studies = n_distinct(Final_ID),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c(
      "RQ",
      "Contribution_Status"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    RQ,
    Contribution_Status
  )

code_level_evidence <- detailed_map |>
  group_by(
    RQ,
    Finding_Strategy_ID,
    Finding_Strategy_Label,
    Contribution_Status
  ) |>
  summarise(
    Assignments = n(),
    Unique_Studies = n_distinct(Final_ID),
    Direct_Studies = n_distinct(
      Final_ID[
        Evidence_Directness ==
          "Direct Data Paper / Data Journal"
      ]
    ),
    Adjacent_Studies = n_distinct(
      Final_ID[
        Evidence_Directness ==
          "Adjacent research-data"
      ]
    ),
    Infrastructure_Studies = n_distinct(
      Final_ID[
        Evidence_Directness ==
          "Infrastructure / mechanism"
      ]
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    RQ,
    Finding_Strategy_ID,
    Contribution_Status
  )

rq4_strategies <- finding_strategy |>
  filter(RQ == "RQ4") |>
  arrange(Finding_Strategy_ID)

rq5_priorities <- finding_strategy |>
  filter(RQ == "RQ5") |>
  arrange(Finding_Strategy_ID)

detailed_codes <- detailed_map |>
  distinct(RQ, Finding_Strategy_ID)

strategy_codes <- finding_strategy |>
  distinct(RQ, Finding_Strategy_ID)

core_assignments <- sum(
  detailed_map$Contribution_Status == "Core contributing evidence",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

contextual_assignments <- sum(
  detailed_map$Contribution_Status == "Contextual/supporting evidence",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

map_checks <- tibble(
  Check = c(
    "S7 study IDs match included-study IDs",
    "Core and contextual assignments partition all S7 assignments",
    "Detailed-map pairs match study-coverage pairs",
    "Detailed-map codes match finding-strategy codes"
  ),
  Observed = c(
    sprintf("%d S7 IDs; %d included-study IDs", length(coding_ids), length(extraction_ids)),
    sprintf("%d core + %d contextual = %d assignments", core_assignments, contextual_assignments, nrow(detailed_map)),
    sprintf("%d detailed-map pairs; %d coverage pairs", nrow(detailed_pairs), nrow(coverage_pairs)),
    sprintf("%d detailed-map codes; %d strategy codes", nrow(detailed_codes), nrow(strategy_codes))
  ),
  Status = c(
    if_else(identical(coding_ids, extraction_ids), "PASS", "FAIL"),
    if_else(
      core_assignments + contextual_assignments == nrow(detailed_map) &&
        all(detailed_map$Contribution_Status %in% valid_contribution_statuses),
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    ),
    if_else(
      nrow(anti_join(detailed_pairs, coverage_pairs, by = c("Final_ID", "RQ"))) == 0 &&
        nrow(anti_join(coverage_pairs, detailed_pairs, by = c("Final_ID", "RQ"))) == 0,
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    ),
    if_else(
      nrow(anti_join(detailed_codes, strategy_codes, by = c("RQ", "Finding_Strategy_ID"))) == 0 &&
        nrow(anti_join(strategy_codes, detailed_codes, by = c("RQ", "Finding_Strategy_ID"))) == 0,
      "PASS", "FAIL"
    )
  )
)

if (any(map_checks$Status == "FAIL")) {
  stop("S7 evidence-map audit failed. Inspect the printed audit results.")
}

print(contribution_summary)
print(rq4_strategies)
print(rq5_priorities)
```

# Reviewer agreement and adjudication

```{r}
agreement_summary <- function(data, scope, reviewer_a_column, reviewer_b_column) {
  reviewer_a <- if_else(
    is.na(data[[reviewer_a_column]]) |
      str_squish(as.character(data[[reviewer_a_column]])) == "",
    "N/A",
    str_squish(as.character(data[[reviewer_a_column]]))
  )
  reviewer_b <- if_else(
    is.na(data[[reviewer_b_column]]) |
      str_squish(as.character(data[[reviewer_b_column]])) == "",
    "N/A",
    str_squish(as.character(data[[reviewer_b_column]]))
  )

  tibble(
    Scope = scope,
    Judgements = length(reviewer_a),
    Agreements = sum(reviewer_a == reviewer_b),
    Agreement_pct = round(mean(reviewer_a == reviewer_b) * 100, 1),
    Cohens_kappa = round(cohen_kappa(reviewer_a, reviewer_b), 3)
  )
}

full_text_agreement <- bind_rows(
  agreement_summary(
    full_text_reviewer_audit,
    "All full-text reports",
    "Reviewer_A_Decision",
    "Reviewer_B_Decision"
  ),
  agreement_summary(
    full_text_reviewer_audit |>
      filter(
        str_to_lower(str_squish(Eligibility_Only_Comparable)) == "yes"
      ),
    "Eligibility-only comparable reports",
    "Reviewer_A_Decision",
    "Reviewer_B_Decision"
  )
)

ebl_agreement <- agreement_summary(
  ebl_reviewer_audit,
  "All paired EBL item judgements",
  "Reviewer_A_Rating",
  "Reviewer_B_Rating"
)

normalise_audit_rating <- function(rating) {
  if_else(
    is.na(rating) | str_squish(as.character(rating)) == "",
    "N/A",
    str_squish(as.character(rating))
  )
}

ebl_adjudication_classified <- ebl_adjudication_audit |>
  transmute(
    Reviewer_A_Rating = normalise_audit_rating(Reviewer_A_Rating),
    Reviewer_B_Rating = normalise_audit_rating(Reviewer_B_Rating),
    Final_Adjudication = normalise_audit_rating(Final_Adjudication)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Adjudication_Outcome = case_when(
      Final_Adjudication == Reviewer_A_Rating ~
        "Final agrees with Reviewer A",
      Final_Adjudication == Reviewer_B_Rating ~
        "Final agrees with Reviewer B",
      TRUE ~
        "Final differs from both initial ratings"
    )
  )

adjudication_levels <- c(
  "Final agrees with Reviewer A",
  "Final agrees with Reviewer B",
  "Final differs from both initial ratings"
)

ebl_adjudication_summary <- ebl_adjudication_classified |>
  count(
    Adjudication_Outcome,
    name = "Items"
  ) |>
  complete(
    Adjudication_Outcome = adjudication_levels,
    fill = list(Items = 0)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Adjudication_Outcome = factor(
      Adjudication_Outcome,
      levels = adjudication_levels
    ),
    Percent_of_adjudicated = round(
      percent_of(Items, nrow(ebl_adjudication_audit)),
      1
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(Adjudication_Outcome) |>
  mutate(Adjudication_Outcome = as.character(Adjudication_Outcome))

adjudication_required_n <- sum(
  str_to_lower(str_squish(ebl_reviewer_audit$Adjudication_Required)) == "yes",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (adjudication_required_n != nrow(ebl_adjudication_audit)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "EBL adjudication audit mismatch: ",
      adjudication_required_n,
      " paired-item disagreements but ",
      nrow(ebl_adjudication_audit),
      " adjudication-log rows."
    )
  )
}

print(full_text_agreement)
print(ebl_agreement)
print(ebl_adjudication_summary)
```
